classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Compact binder-design workflow: two BindCraft seed shards (one design each) against the user-supplied target structure, ipSAE interface scoring on each design, and rank_designs aggregation to surface the top candidate.
assumptions: target_pdb must be supplied at runtime; no default structure is available, so it is declared as a required workflow parameter.
Hotspot residues are left unspecified; BindCraft will perform hotspot-free design guided by AF2 energy.
BindCraft places the binder on chain B and the target on chain A in its output complex; ipSAE is wired accordingly.
filter_mode=permissive is chosen to maximise the probability of obtaining a passing design when only one trajectory per shard is run.
binder_length=60 (tool default) and num_recycles=1 (tool default) are retained for minimal compute cost.
Two seed shards (seed 1 and seed 2) provide independent trajectories for diversity at a two-GPU budget.
rank_designs top_k=2 returns both candidates ranked by composite metrics so the agent can select the top one after outputs are available.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target PDB structure file (required by bindcraft; no default can be inferred from the request)

success_criteria.ranked_table: rank_designs returns a scored, ranked table of the two binder candidates
